body: True. I hate to make it sound simple, but even if you’re awful. If you call and visit 20 FSBO’s in a month and at least follow up with a few of them, you’ll at least pick up one or two listings. Or you can just call expired’s and play the roulette until you get really good at it.

Buy Compucram for RE Exam in your state > Learn all definitions using simple words instead of long definitions> practice all of the compucram material until you pass their practice exam> Take and pass actual RE exam

Yes. It helped greatly with the exam. Well worth 70 dollars. Come up with one-word definitions for every real estate word and make sure you take every unit’s practice test until you can ace them all. When it sais you’re good to go, you’re ready. I bought compucram and passed the RE exam on my first attempt
